children: Hermes should report steady revenue growth for the third quarter, helped by a strong performance in the Americas region, RBC Capital Markets analyst Piral Dadhania writes in a note. Growth at the French luxury house remains stable, though an improvement in the second half compared with the first six months is unlikely, Dadhania says. This is due to a more challenging luxury demand environment, he says. Shares closed at 1,344 euros on Monday. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
